 */

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int max_size = 0;
        int num_words = 0;
        int max_size1 = 0;
        int k = -1;
        int t = 0;
        int tmp_size = 0;
        int tmp_size1 = 0;
        boolean scob = false;
        String str = in.next();
        char [] arr = str.toCharArray();
        for(int i=0; i<n;i++){
            if(arr[i]=='(') {
                scob = true;
                k=1;
                if(tmp_size1!=0){
                    max_size = Math.max(max_size,tmp_size1);
                    tmp_size1 = 0;
                }
            }
            ///////////

                scob = false;
                if(arr[i-1]!='_' && arr[i-1]!='(')
                    k=-1;
            }
            ///////////////
            if(scob){
                if(t!=1) {
                    if (arr[i] != '_' && arr[i] != '(' && arr[i] != ')') {
                        num_words++;
                        t = 1;
                    }
                }
                if(arr[i] == '_' || arr[i] == '(' || arr[i] == ')')
                    t=0;

            }
            else{
                if(arr[i]!='_' && arr[i]!=')' && arr[i]!='('){
                    tmp_size1++;
                    if(i==(n-1)){
                        max_size = Math.max(max_size, tmp_size1);
                    }
                }else{
                    if(tmp_size1!=0) {
                        max_size = Math.max(max_size, tmp_size1);
                        tmp_size1 = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_size+" "+num_words);
    }
}
